help: What a config spec can do, for a mod author writing one: one of each kind of setting, a page for each kind in all its forms, and its mistakes.

content.text: A config spec that shows what a config spec can do, for a mod author writing one. General has one of each kind of setting, and the patterns a page uses most. Detailed Examples has a page for each kind, in all its forms, and Mistakes has what a config spec can get wrong, each with the error the menu reports. Its values are in files of its own, beside its spec.json.

pages.help: A page for each kind of row and setting, in all its forms, and what a config spec can get wrong.

content.text: The controls come first, from a switcher to an activation sphere. Then the look of a page, from text and images to sections, pages and read-only values. Then how settings behave: their files, when a change takes effect, conditions, warnings and translations. Mistakes is last.

content.help: Its applies is not unknown, live, save or restart, so it has the config spec's.
Its id is the one the front page's switcher has from its path.
It has no options, so it is disabled.
It names a shared list the config spec does not have, so it has no options.
Of its four options, a text and a number are left out: they are not texts it stores.

content.text: A default that is no option
content.help: Its default is none of its options, so it has no Reset.

content.text: A FormList that is not in the game
content.help: Its listFromForm names a plugin that is not loaded, so it has no options and is not available.
Its condition names a setting the config spec does not have, so it is shown.
Its condition compares a switcher with a number, so it is shown.
Its condition asks whether a text is above a number, so it is enabled.

content.text: A part that is not one
content.help: One part of its condition names no setting, so all of it is left out, and it is shown.
Its condition names a setting and does not say how it is compared, so it is shown.
Of its three warnings, one has no text and one names no setting, so only the last is told: while it is on.

content.text: A style and an icon that are not ones
content.help: Its style and its icon are none the menu has, so it is drawn without them.

params: Showcase: a style and an icon that are not ones

content.help: A button that does not say what it runs.
Its action does not say what it is.
Its CallFunction does not name the form of its script.

content.text: A parameter that is an object
content.help: A parameter is a whole number, a number, a bool or a text.
Its RunConsoleCommand has no command.
A CallExternalFunction calls a Flash function, which a config spec does not have.

content.text: A form that is not in the game
content.help: Its form is of a plugin the game does not have: a press runs nothing, and the log says why.

content.text: It says it starts folded, and it has no isCollapsible, so it could not be opened: it is open.

content.help: A row of a type that is not one.
A row that does not say what it is.
Its visibleWen is not read: the menu does not know the field, and the log names the one it is near.
